digest.component_or_area: test suite infrastructure / regression oracle equivalence
propositions: The generic reads-under-sync-contention property does not subsume the original CLI show regression test; both oracles must be retained because seeds F3 (empty-dict exit-0) and F6 (missing ticket_id) are caught only by the original test.

Reverting the slim-fetch-ledge fix (reconverge-lock timeout 2→15) leaves both burst tests passing; only the deterministic held-lock tests detect the original regression, indicating burst tests are weak oracles for that specific race.
The generic property catches two failure classes (F5: 35s stall, F7: empty list output) that the original test misses, confirming the tests are complements rather than duplicates.
Test deletion would decrease mutation score by losing detection of partial-success payloads (shape-valid but content-incomplete records), violating the established criterion for safe test removal.

Both tests exhibit real process concurrency, subprocess timeout enforcement, cleanup, and process killing, confirmed through seed F5 timeout-triggered subprocess termination and lock-holder thread joining.
